Containers.Name: FanControl Plus 2
Containers.Description: Automatic fan speed control based on HDD, NVMe, Unassigned Devices, CPU, IPMI baseboard and SAS/HBA controller temperatures. When several sources are enabled, the fan runs at the highest speed any of them asks for. IPMI needs the IPMI Tools plugin and SAS needs HBAviewer for StorCLI2; both are optional - without them those sections are simply hidden.
